newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Foreign selling hurts 10-yr OLO, others well bid.
newsitem.headline: Foreign selling hurts 10-yr OLO, others well bid.

text.p: A dip in U.S. Treasuries in the afternoon and foreign sellers brought the Belgian 10-year OLO under pressure on Friday, but other maturities showed a good performance, dealers said.
The 2006 OLO finished yielding 6.62 percent compared to 6.60 on Thursday, while its premium over equivalent German paper squeezed in one basis point to 23 bp.
"We seem to be doing very well. There were foreign sellers in 10 years but strength in everything else. Twenty years is performing excellently and five years is well bid," one dealer said.
"The U.S. market was sold off, but Europe held up quite well," he added. Treasuries extended Thursday's drop in reaction to more strong economic data.
Front-month Belgian bond futures closed seven basis points down at 116.44.
In the money market three-month T-bill rates were a fraction lower at 3.10/14 percent compared to 3.11/16 on Thursday.
The franc held at the day's slightly firmer levels to the mark, closing at 20.5930/50
